import json, torch, time, sys
import torch.nn.functional as F
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM

model_path = "checkpoints/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B"
print("Loading tokenizer...", flush=True)
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path)
print("Loading model to CPU (bf16)...", flush=True)
t0 = time.time()
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map="cpu")
model.eval()
print(f"Model loaded in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s", flush=True)

with open("data/gpqa_diamond.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# ============ Task A: Raw output (1 sample first to check speed) ============
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("TASK A: Raw output format")
print("="*60, flush=True)

longest_response = ""
for i in range(min(3, len(data))):
    problem = data[i]["problem"]
    t1 = time.time()
    inputs = tok(problem, return_tensors="pt")
    input_len = inputs.input_ids.shape[1]
    with torch.no_grad():
        out = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=200, do_sample=False)
    elapsed = time.time() - t1
    response = tok.decode(out[0][input_len:], skip_special_tokens=False)
    if len(response) > len(longest_response):
        longest_response = response
        longest_full = tok.decode(out[0], skip_special_tokens=False)
    
    print(f"\n--- Problem {i} ({elapsed:.1f}s, {input_len} input toks) ---")
    print(f"Domain: {data[i].get('domain','?')}")
    print(f"Response:\n{response}")
    print(f"Has <think>: {'<think>' in response}")
    print(f"Has </think>: {'</think>' in response}")
    markers = ['let me', 'first', 'step', 'because', 'therefore', 'thus', 'so,', 'hence']
    found = [m for m in markers if m in response.lower()]
    print(f"Reasoning markers: {found}")
    print(f"Token count: {out.shape[1] - input_len}", flush=True)
    
    # If first sample took >120s, stop at 1
    if i == 0 and elapsed > 120:
        print(f"\nFirst sample took {elapsed:.0f}s, limiting to 1 sample for Task A")
        break

# ============ Task B: System prompt elicitation ============
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("TASK B: System prompt elicitation")
print("="*60, flush=True)

# v1: explicit <think> instruction
messages_v1 = [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant. Always think step by step inside <think></think> tags before giving your final answer."},
    {"role": "user", "content": data[0]["problem"]}
]
text_v1 = tok.apply_chat_template(messages_v1, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)

# v2: native chat template
messages_v2 = [
    {"role": "user", "content": data[0]["problem"]}
]
text_v2 = tok.apply_chat_template(messages_v2, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)

print(f"\nv1 template prefix (last 200 chars): ...{text_v1[-200:]}")
print(f"v2 template prefix (last 200 chars): ...{text_v2[-200:]}")

for label, text in [("v1_system_think", text_v1), ("v2_native_chat", text_v2)]:
    t1 = time.time()
    inputs = tok(text, return_tensors="pt")
    input_len = inputs.input_ids.shape[1]
    with torch.no_grad():
        out = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=200, do_sample=False)
    elapsed = time.time() - t1
    response = tok.decode(out[0][input_len:], skip_special_tokens=False)
    print(f"\n--- {label} ({elapsed:.1f}s) ---")
    print(f"Response:\n{response[:500]}")
    print(f"Has <think>: {'<think>' in response}")
    print(f"Has </think>: {'</think>' in response}")
    print(f"Token count: {out.shape[1] - input_len}", flush=True)
    
    if label == "v2_native_chat" and len(response) > len(longest_response):
        longest_response = response
        longest_full = tok.decode(out[0], skip_special_tokens=False)

# ============ Task C: PPL profile ============
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("TASK C: PPL profile")
print("="*60, flush=True)

if len(longest_response) > 30:
    inputs = tok(longest_full, return_tensors="pt")
    with torch.no_grad():
        logits = model(**inputs).logits
    shift_logits = logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()
    shift_labels = inputs.input_ids[..., 1:].contiguous()
    loss_per_token = F.cross_entropy(
        shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.size(-1)),
        shift_labels.view(-1),
        reduction='none'
    )
    ppl_values = loss_per_token.float().numpy()
    n = len(ppl_values)
    q1 = n // 4
    print(f"Total tokens: {n}")
    print(f"Mean loss: {ppl_values.mean():.3f}")
    print(f"Std loss: {ppl_values.std():.3f}")
    print(f"First 25% mean: {ppl_values[:q1].mean():.3f}")
    print(f"Second 25% mean: {ppl_values[q1:2*q1].mean():.3f}")
    print(f"Third 25% mean: {ppl_values[2*q1:3*q1].mean():.3f}")
    print(f"Last 25% mean: {ppl_values[3*q1:].mean():.3f}")
    print(f"Min loss: {ppl_values.min():.3f}")
    print(f"Max loss: {ppl_values.max():.3f}")
    
    # Print per-token loss for last 50 tokens (generated part)
    print(f"\nPer-token loss (last 50 tokens of generated response):")
    for j in range(max(0, n-50), n):
        token_str = tok.decode([inputs.input_ids[0][j+1].item()])
        print(f"  [{j:4d}] loss={ppl_values[j]:.3f}  token='{token_str}'")
else:
    print(f"Longest response too short ({len(longest_response)} chars), skipping PPL analysis")

print("\n" + "="*60)
